name: Poisson Surface Reconstruction for Mesh Export
aliases: TSDF Fusion and Screened Poisson Reconstruction
definition: A method to export watertight, colored triangle meshes from 3D Gaussians by solving a Poisson equation on an oriented point cloud derived from the Gaussian splats.
summary: Poisson Surface Reconstruction for Mesh Export generates watertight, colored triangle meshes from implicit representations by solving a Poisson equation on an oriented point cloud, avoiding the non-watertight results of marching cubes.
